correctness.rationale: The largest-label cycle-insertion bijection gives an independent uniform insertion site. For a record position j, insertion before j kills the record, insertion at j creates it, and insertion after j preserves the smaller permutation's record event. This yields the exact recurrence for E[C_n R_{n,j}], which after centering solves to the displayed positive binomial kernel. Summation and standard independent-Bernoulli representations give the total covariance, variances, and asymptotics.

value.rationale: Cycle count and upper-record count are canonical equidistributed statistics of a uniform permutation, so their same-object dependence is a natural structural question. The exact local kernel separates equidistribution from independence and shows that every nontrivial record coordinate carries the same positive-sign interaction with cycle count. The total asymptotic quantifies how this finite dependence becomes negligible after standardization.
